### VX Client v0.1.5 Release Notes

- Dynamic Launcher Versioning: Settings & splash screen now dynamically display the active version.
- Home Page 3D Skin: Spinning rotation disabled; character faces forward, continuously waves hand, and moves head towards the cursor.
- Partnership Popup Banner: Displays wide 16:9 banner images with logo avatars and clean fallback.
- Responsive UI & Translucent Sidebar: Smooth layout scaling across all window resize states.
- Verified Cryptographic Updates: Production Minisign signed update flow.
